filters.wild_type_only: Activities with assay_variant_mutation set were excluded: a mutant receptor is a different protein.
filters.validity: Records carrying a ChEMBL data_validity_comment were excluded.
filters.deduplication: Records sharing (molecule, document, rounded pChEMBL) were collapsed to one measurement.
filters.excluded: IC50 and EC50 were excluded: IC50 depends on radioligand concentration via Cheng-Prusoff, and EC50 is a functional measurement. Pooling them would mix physical quantities.

noise_estimate.caveat: Computed after collapsing duplicate records, so it reflects distinct reported measurements. It still understates true inter-laboratory variation, since agreement within a curated database is not independent replication.
